title: TONGSHU Evidence v1.2
description: Schema for Evidence records. Evidence is the textual / scholarly backing for a Rule. Per architecture_decisions_v1.md §0.1 Preamble, Evidence MUST be cited; per DECISION-009, gaps MUST be UNRESOLVED, not fabricated. v1.1 (M2-A): 新增必填 source_layer(五层机械映射)、可选 edition_id(work→book→pinned edition;工程种子缺省)、可选 citation.verification_status(仅在有核验记录处填写)。v1.2 (M2-B, additive): 新增可选 cluster_id(证据去重归并,Evidence Cluster 成员)与 provenance_note(M2-B 审查/迁移溯源记录)。

citation.description: Verbatim citation from the source classical text.

verification_status.description: M2-A: 引文核验状态。仅在有核验记录处填写;机械映射:BAZI-00x 双源→cross_verified、paraphrase(待校,paraphrase)→pending_verification、工程种子→not_applicable。无核验记录(35 条 ZPZ 逐字)→缺省。M2-B:30 条 E-ZPZ-101..130 经程序化逐字一致断言(0 mismatch)与 P-ZPZ-YONGSHEN.classical_original.text 核为同一文本,继承该 passage 的 verified(单源,通行本句读从排印本;非 cross_verified)——机械继承,非模型推断。identity verification ≠ basis verification ≠ passage verification,不得合并。

source_layer.description: M2-A: 证据所在五层之一(机械映射,KB_SCHEMA_FINAL §6):逐字 classical→classical_original;`(待校,paraphrase)`前缀→paraphrase;工程种子/spec 引文→engineering_seed;二手转述→secondary_reference。

edition_id.description: M2-A: 引文所属固化版本(work→book→pinned edition)。工程种子证据(E-ZPZ-001..005/E-QTB-014/E-ZIWEI-001/E-ZW-405..408,引文来自 spec/工程非经典版本)缺省。

cluster_id.description: M2-B: 所属 Evidence Cluster 成员(证据去重归并,保留全部 source provenance)。30 条 E-ZPZ-101..130 归并 CLUSTER-ZPZ-YONGSHEN-ANCHOR。仅 cluster 成员填写;非成员缺省。

provenance_note.description: M2-B: 审查/迁移溯源记录(核验依据、批次、诚实性边界)。仅在有审查记录处填写;缺省表示无 M2-B 审查记录。

modern_paraphrase.description: Modern-language paraphrase. OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED for downstream validator use.

source_locator.description: Bibliographic locator. SHOULD match Rule.source if Evidence supports a single Rule.

evidence_strength.description: Scholarly strength. primary = canonical text; secondary = commentary; tertiary = derived/translated.

commentary_refs.description: References to commentaries on this passage (e.g., 沈孝瞻注).

applicability_conditions.description: Free-text description of when this evidence applies.
